title: Cursed and Blessed: The Heart's Deceit Before the Lord
description: Jeremiah conveys the Lord's judgment over Judah's sin, which is engraved on the tablet of the heart. He proclaims a curse upon those who trust in humans and a blessing upon those who set their hope in the Lord. The heart is deceitful and incurable, but the Lord searches it and repays each according to their deeds. The prophet himself prays for healing, deliverance, and protection from his persecutors on the day of disaster.
